request: Small wrecks need jaggedness, especially Medium: punched holes, jutting fragments, less circular pancake.

jobs.emphasis: The current SMALL wreck already has a useful balance of one or two larger pieces with little fragments. Retain that balance and overall amount of material; make its contour more broken and jagged with three or four clearly projecting thin torn shards and a few irregular holes.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied generic robotic wreck token. The current SMALL wreck already has a useful balance of one or two larger pieces with little fragments. Retain that balance and overall amount of material; make its contour more broken and jagged with three or four clearly projecting thin torn shards and a few irregular holes.

The GM asks for a JAGGED HEAP of violently destroyed parts: punch torn holes through the heap, pull out a few jutting fragments, interrupt broad edges and create some deep gaps. This is not neatly sorted material spread evenly over a circle. Keep a physically connected wreck with believable overlaps and clear large/medium/small shape hierarchy. Preserve recognizability as anonymous mechanical remains and the overall pile size, but the contour may change deliberately. Avoid repeated evenly sized motors and uniform coverage.
Maintain the existing grounded painterly rendering and cooled scorched materials. Ripped sheet metal should have raw angular teeth, folded corners and fractured edges alongside occasional cooled melted blobs. Include blackened, fused interiors and scorched wire; no clean functioning parts. Retain enough broad readable surfaces that it stays clear when reduced to a small game token.
Strict directly overhead orthographic view. Center the FULL jagged outline in a square transparent canvas; longest extent roughly 70%, including all protrusions. Leave transparent margins on every side. The new holes and gaps must be genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha, not painted black spots. Neutral upper-left object illumination; no floor, ground, base, ring, crater, ash carpet, separate ground debris, smoke, active flame, glowing embers, cast shadows outside the wreck, people, lettering or watermark. No robot face, head, intact humanoid anatomy or recognizable model. Not a round pancake.

jobs.emphasis: The current MEDIUM wreck is too circular and evenly packed, like a pancake of spare parts. Make a substantial compositional correction: remove two large bites from different edges, open several unequal jagged holes right through the interior, and project a few torn armor fins and snapped support fragments well outside the former round perimeter. Keep an off-center compact main mass, a thinner tail of caught wreckage and uneven little satellites still attached by bent wire or metal. Strongly asymmetric outline with visible negative space, rather than a round disk.
